entries.description: Local supervisor for the databases, brokers and services a coding agent's stack needs — declared in an Alphasfile, run as host processes. Exposes an MCP server over stdio via `zordon mcp`. Install with `brew install piotrkowalczuk/tap/zordon`, an .mcpb bundle, or the Claude Code plugin.
representativeQueries: spin up a local dev stack for my coding agent
run databases and services for an AI agent to test against
provision an isolated workspace for an agent
manage a local MCP-driven development environment
